title: The Maharashtra Miscellaneous Alienations (in Hyderabad Enclaves) Abolition Act, 1965.

CHAPTER I PRELIMINARY CHAPTER II ABOLITION OF ALIENATIONS AND CONFERMENT OF OCCUPANCY RIGHTS CHAPTER III COMPENSATION AND AWARD THEREOF CHAPTER IV MISCELLANEOUS Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Act not to apply to certain kinds of alienations. Section 4. Powers of Collector to decide certain questions. Section 5. Abolition of alienations and rights and incidents in respect thereof. Section 6. Liability of alienated lands to payment of land revenue. Section 7. Regrant of land forming part of community service inam or watan. Section 8. Conferment of occupancy rights in alienated land to which provisions of section 7 or 9 do not apply. Section 9. Disposal of community service inam land or watan land in possession of unauthorised holder. Section 10. Regrant of land subject to Maharashtra Act XXVII of 1961. Section 11. All public roads, etc., situate in inam lands to vest in Government. Section 12. Rights to trees. Section 13. Compensation in respect of alienation consisting of assignment of land revenue. Section 14. Compensation to watandar for abolition of right of service. Section 15. Compensation to alienees for extinguishment of rights in properties referred to in section 11. Section 16. Method for awarding compensation to alienee. Section 17. Method of awarding compensation for abolition, etc., of rights of other person in property. Section 18. Provision of Land Acquisition Act applicable to the term of award and previous approval required in certain cases. Section 19. Appeal against award of Collector. Section 20. Procedure before Revenue Tribunal. Section 21. Limitation. Section 22. Court-fees. Section 23. Finality of award and decision of Revenue Tribunal. Section 24. Inquiries and proceedings to be judicial proceedings. Section 25. Compensation to be paid in cash. Section 26. Amount of arrears of land revenue, etc., to be deducted from the amount of compensation. Section 27. Application of Bom. LXVII of 1948 to leases of alienated land. Section 28. Special rule of succession to be void. Section 29. Delegation of powers. Section 30. Rules. Section 31. Saving.
